fov.aggregation: minimum across required outputs; never average
fov.denominator: frozen native active-pixel mask of the common-input anchor
fov.numerator: denominator pixels covered by finite non-padding output samples with independently reconstructed source support

run.duplicate_depth_state: fail if any eligible tile at that depth fails
run.partition: one-dimensional Voronoi cells of sorted unique best indices

source_signal.luminance: linear ProPhoto RGB D50 Y = 0.2880402 R + 0.7118741 G + 0.0000857 B
source_signal.normalization: divide each spatial block by its positive arithmetic mean, subtract one, then window
source_signal.passes: average block cross-powers over complete input passes; one pass is permitted
source_signal.spatial_blocks: sixteen non-overlapping 32x32 blocks inside each 128x128 tile

tile.anchor: top-left of frozen common-input anchor active rectangle

wilson.pooled_rule: sum successes and distinct physical-site units after within-session duplicate collapse; every capture must also pass
wilson.unit: one distinct non-overlapping eligible physical tile; frames, passes, channels, Fourier coefficients, and bootstrap draws never increase n
wilson.within_session_duplicate: same subject coordinate across required A/B or step-width outputs counts once and succeeds only if every required output succeeds
